'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory Ryan Muench; sheet Ryan Mason.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
